import json
import pytest
from part2.capital_flow.contracts import FlowObservation
from part2.capital_flow.runner import run_once

CLOCK = 1787520123456
CASES = [
    ({}, False), ({"context_only": False}, False),
    ({"context_only": True}, True), ({"context_only": " false "}, False),
    ({"context_only": "TRUE"}, True), ({"context_only": "maybe"}, True),
    ({"context_only": None}, True), ({"context_only": ""}, True),
    ({"context_only": []}, True),
]

def observation(record_id, provenance, *, available_at_ms=CLOCK-10000):
    return FlowObservation(
        family="etf", metric="etf_netflow_btc", asset="BTC", value=10.0,
        unit="BTC", effective_at_ms=CLOCK-20000,
        available_at_ms=available_at_ms, observed_at_ms=available_at_ms,
        source="offline_fixture", source_record_id=record_id,
        cadence_seconds=3600, provenance=provenance,
    )

@pytest.mark.parametrize("provenance,is_context", CASES)
def test_runner_handoff_role_parity(tmp_path, provenance, is_context):
    row = observation("one", provenance)
    (tmp_path / "observations.jsonl").write_text(
        json.dumps(row.to_dict()) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    result = run_once(local_dir=tmp_path, network=False,
                      external_jsonl=(), as_of_ms=CLOCK)
    assert result["source_errors"] == []
    assert result["archive_records_loaded"] == 1
    assert result["scoring_records_loaded"] == int(not is_context)
    audit = json.loads((tmp_path / "audit_latest.json").read_text())
    handoff = json.loads((tmp_path / "anata_latest.json").read_text())
    assert audit["context_only_observation_count"] == int(is_context)
    assert handoff["families"]["etf"]["scoring_observation_count"] == int(not is_context)
    assert handoff["families"]["etf"]["context_observation_count"] == int(is_context)

def test_archive_wide_vs_pit_visible_count(tmp_path):
    rows = [
        observation("visible", {"context_only": False}),
        observation("future", {"context_only": True}, available_at_ms=CLOCK+60000),
    ]
    (tmp_path / "observations.jsonl").write_text(
        "".join(json.dumps(row.to_dict()) + "\n" for row in rows), encoding="utf-8")
    result = run_once(local_dir=tmp_path, network=False,
                      external_jsonl=(), as_of_ms=CLOCK)
    audit = json.loads((tmp_path / "audit_latest.json").read_text())
    handoff = json.loads((tmp_path / "anata_latest.json").read_text())
    assert result["archive_records_loaded"] == 2
    assert result["scoring_records_loaded"] == 1
    assert audit["context_only_observation_count"] == 1
    assert handoff["families"]["etf"]["scoring_observation_count"] == 1
    assert handoff["families"]["etf"]["context_observation_count"] == 0
    assert handoff["evidence_health"]["families"]["etf"]["visible_observation_count"] == 1
